rows.name: Diamond Transformation
rows.effect_description: Encases skin in impenetrable diamond; absorbs 80% damage and increases brawling damage by 2.5x for 8 seconds.

rows.name: Telepathic Shockwave
rows.effect_description: Projects mental wave stunning nearby kindred and mortals, causing mass disorientation for 5 seconds.

rows.name: Cerebro Override (Ultimate)
rows.effect_description: Completely subdues targets in a 15m radius, forcing hostiles to fight each other while restoring masquerade stability.

rows.name: Whip Line & Acrobatics
rows.effect_description: Launches grappling cable toward rooftops or targets, propelling Felicia forward at hyper-velocity with 100% dodge.

rows.name: Vicious Claws Flurry
rows.effect_description: Multi-slash melee combo applying deep lacerations that drain enemy blood and vitality over 4 seconds.

rows.name: Jinx Aura (Ultimate)
rows.effect_description: Afflicts all nearby enemies with catastrophic misfortune: firearms jam, melee attacks backfire, critical hits guaranteed.

rows.name: Refractive Invisibility
rows.effect_description: Bends light around Sue, granting total invisibility even while moving, breaking enemy aggro instantly.

rows.name: Psionic Force Shield
rows.effect_description: Deploys a directional spherical barrier deflecting all incoming ballistic and occult attacks.

rows.name: Force Wave Detonation (Ultimate)
rows.effect_description: Expands a high-density kinetic sphere that knocks all targets back into walls, dealing devastating impact damage.
